messages:
maya (prod): RCA live: short summary — autoscaler interaction with warm-pool reclamation caused model fallback thrash for ~20m. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/rca/1823456789 (internal)
incident-bot: Postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/docs/rca/1823456789 :white_check_mark:
ravi (oncall): I'll own Fix-1 (reclaim ordering + simple mutex). Plan: add unit test + hotfix, then roll. ETA 2026-04-06.
dina (eng-runtime): Taking Fix-2 (model routing safeguards + extra invariant checks). Adding an e2e test and a metric `variant_fallbacks`. ETA 2026-03-31.
otto (sre): Mitigation deployed: bumped warm-pool min and tightened health checks to reduce immediate reclaim. Will monitor and post graphs.
maya (prod): Action list (in doc):
- Fix-1: reclaim ordering mutex — @ravi — ETA 2026-04-06
- Fix-2: routing invariants & tests — @dina — ETA 2026-03-31
- Fix-3: rollout gating + canary thresholds — @otto — Checkpoint 2026-03-29 11:00 PT
- Comm: customer note & internal FAQ — @maya — ETA EOD today
jordan (ceo): Good work on the RCA. Please prioritize customer note; include dedicated vs hosted behavior.
ravi (oncall): Will add repro script to the PR and tag @eng-sre for review.
dina (eng-runtime): Posting dashboard links for `variant_fallbacks` and `kv_invalidate_failures` before the checkpoint.
otto (sre): Canary plan: run 2% traffic with tighter latency SLO. If stable for 30m, we proceed. Will post results here.
maya (prod): Scheduling follow-up sync 2026-03-29 11:00 PT (20m). Update the RCA doc if blocked.
incident-bot: RCA doc updated: 3 open actions, 1 mitigation in place.
jordan (ceo): Leadership note: impact ~0.4% of requests, containment good. Keep updates coming after canary.
maya (prod): Closing thread; RCA doc is source of truth, tag me for blockers.
